REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Review receipts are signed and patch-bound, but their subject digest omits substantial execution identity and content. Because attempt IDs are not recomputed from receipt content, an approval can be replayed onto a newly attested execution with different roots, profile/model, adapter command, telemetry, scope, or result commit while retaining the same attempt label.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|review_subject_digest omits execution-receipt identity/content and attempt_id is only format-checked|the validator can reuse an old approval for a materially different execution bundle, contradicting the stated replay-resistance and exact-bundle binding
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Bind each accepted review to a canonical digest of the complete harness-attested execution receipt, or include every execution binding field and make attempt_id content-derived; add a negative replay fixture changing profile/model, roots, telemetry, scope, or result_commit.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Re-sign valid-provenance-refactor-qwen-review’s execution/provenance after changing Qwen to Claude and altering telemetry/scope, retain its attempt_id, patch, evidence, Skill, paths, and gate manifest, then reuse the original signed review receipt; the current subject digest is unchanged and validation accepts it.
